$sources: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 85(1) table, column (ii): the floor live load for the design of beams, columns and foundations

sources.method: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 85(1): beams and columns take the use's value for frames (areaLoads frameLive) in place of the slabs' value; a member under several uses the largest ratio (SAEngine practice). Applied where Analysis > Live load reduction is on (the project setting). The reduction of the columns' load by the number of floors carried (Art. 85(2)) is not covered.
